As a bonus action, the troll can reattach the extremity. While the troll is missing the extremity, its maximum hit points are reduced by 10. Roll d6 to determine the severed extremity:

actions.name: Multiattack

a5e-mm_chain-devil.name: Chain Devil

actions.desc: The chain devil makes two chain attacks and commands up to two animated chains under its control to make chain attacks.

When the devil uses Multiattack, the devil may command the chain to make one Chain attack against a target within 15 feet of it. If the chain is reduced to 0 hit points, it can't be reanimated.

reactions.name: Unnerving Mask
reactions.desc: When damaged by a creature within 30 feet that can see the devil, the devil momentarily assumes the magical illusory form of one of the attackers enemies or loved ones, alive or dead. On a failure, it takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn.The attacker is then immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

special_abilities.desc: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Rattling Chains
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the devil moves, the rattling of its chains can be heard up to 300 feet away, unless it moves at half its Speed.

special_abilities.desc: Once the devil has grappled a creature in its chains, it has advantage on ability checks made to track that creature for the next 30 days.

1/día.

special_abilities.name: Wakeful
special_abilities.desc: When one of the chimeras heads is asleep, the others are awake.

a5e-mm_clay-guardian.name: Clay Guardian

special_abilities.desc: When the guardian is subjected to acid damage, it instead regains hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.

If it can’t reach a creature, it attacks an object. The guardian stays berserk until it is destroyed or restored to full hit points.

actions.desc: Each non-aberration creature within 60 feet that can hear its moan makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is frightened until the end of the cloakers next turn. When a creature succeeds on this saving throw  it becomes immune to the cloakers moan for 24 hours.

actions.desc:
1/día.

special_abilities.desc: When motionless, the cloaker is indistinguishable from a black cloak or similar cloth or leather article.
